messages.subject: Question
messages.body: Team ledger: your Option A ruling (review/reviser sessions may run read-only script calls; reviser writes its fix map inside its disposition file) arrived after /sc:implement pinned the plan (Task 1 already started; the managed plan cannot change after its first task starts, E-PLAN-CHANGED). Proposal A (recommended): build it inside the existing tasks without editing the plan: add --dry-run to find, answer, verify and sweep --input (validates the input and the anchors, prints the would-be result, writes no file; a test hashes the whole ledger folder, the document and the report before and after and asserts no change), make answer --input accept the reviser's disposition .md (one ledger-input block); the command text, SKILL.md and ledger-step templates then say review and reviser sessions may run only status, verdict and --dry-run calls. Risk: the plan's Constraints still say those sessions 'never run the writing script', so a task reviewer may flag that wording; I would answer such a flag with an operator Ruling quoting your ruling. Proposal B: finish the plan exactly as written (sessions run no script at all), then add --dry-run in a separate follow-up package. Which?
